## PriceSmart Begins Membership Sales in Chile, Advancing Its Expansion to a 14th Market


November, 19, 2026


Download (opens in new window)


*As it prepares to open a club in Santiago in the spring of 2027, PriceSmart launches memberships and a commercial alliance with Banco de Chile*


SAN DIEGO


, Nov. 19, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- PriceSmart, Inc. ("PriceSmart", the "Company," "we", or "our") (NASDAQ: PSMT), operator of 59 warehouse clubs in 12 countries and one U.S. territory, announced that it began selling memberships in Chile on November 10th, ahead of the planned opening of its first club in the country located at Mallplaza Los Dominicos in Las Condes, Santiago, and is expected to open in the spring of 2027.


Chile will become PriceSmart's 14th market, building on a 30-year track record of operating and growing the Membership Club model across the region.


"We are pleased to bring PriceSmart to Chile and to begin welcoming our first Members. Our membership model has proven resilient across very different markets, and we believe it can give Chilean families and small businesses a new and appealing way to shop. We see ourselves as responsible for serving our Members' best interests, working on their behalf to deliver quality and value they can count on. We are encouraged by the early response as we prepare to open our first club in Santiago," said David Price, Chief Executive Officer of PriceSmart.


**Alliance with Banco de Chile**


PriceSmart also announced a commercial alliance with Banco de Chile, one of the country's leading financial institutions. As a first initiative, the bank is offering a welcome bonus in its *Dólares-Premio* loyalty program to customers who purchase a new Membership using their Banco de Chile credit card. The companies are developing additional initiatives to benefit the bank's customers, which will be announced in due course.


**A Model Built on Membership Loyalty**


PriceSmart's model combines local and imported products, a growing private-label offering under the Member's Selection® brand, and services such as optical, bakery, and fresh kitchen. As of August 31, 2026, the Company had more than 2 million membership accounts, representing more than 4 million cardholders across 13 markets, and a membership renewal rate of 90.4%.


***About*** ***PriceSmart***


PriceSmart, headquartered in San Diego, owns and operates U.S.-style membership shopping warehouse clubs in Latin America and the Caribbean, selling high-quality merchandise and services at low prices to PriceSmart Members. PriceSmart operates 59 warehouse clubs in 12 countries and one U.S. territory (ten each in Colombia and Costa Rica; seven each in Panama and Guatemala; six in Dominican Republic; four each in Trinidad and El Salvador; three each in Jamaica and Honduras; two in Nicaragua; and one each in Aruba, Barbados and the United States Virgin Islands). In addition, the Company plans to open one new warehouse club on South Camp Road (Kingston), Jamaica in January 2027, one warehouse club in Villa Nueva, Guatemala in late winter of 2027, one warehouse club in Santo Tomas de Santo Domingo (Heredia), Costa Rica in the spring of 2027, and one warehouse in Comuna Las Condes, Santiago, Chile in the spring of 2027. Once these four new clubs are open, the Company will operate 63 warehouse clubs. Our operating segments are currently the United States, Central America, the Caribbean and Colombia.
